request: Which languages have the most native speakers? Let me rank Mandarin, Spanish, English, Hindi and French. #interactive #short
subtitle: Rank five great languages by native speakers, then see how the order flips when you count everyone who speaks them.

spec.title: Which languages have the most native speakers?

sources.title: Ethnologue: Languages of the World (2025 and 2026 editions)
sources.finding: first-language / total speakers, millions: Mandarin 990 / 1,184; Spanish 484 / 558; English 390 / 1,528; Hindi 345 / 609; French about 75 / 310

commands.speak: Five of the world's great languages. Which has the most native speakers, the people who learned it first, as children?

ask.question: Put these languages in order of native speakers, from most to fewest. Drag the cards, then press Answer.

commands.speak: Mandarin wins by a mile: nearly a billion people grew up speaking it.
Spanish comes second, thanks to Latin America, with almost half a billion.
Then English and Hindi, close together at around three hundred and fifty million or so each.
French, for all its fame, has only about seventy-five million native speakers.
But count everyone who speaks a language, natively or not, and the order changes.
English jumps to first, with about one and a half billion speakers. Most of them learned it as a second language.
So the world's most spoken language is mostly spoken with an accent.
